title: Collective Reductions Read Off a Granite Ridge Season Pass
content:
The Granite Ridge Mountain Collective publishes, for each Season Pass Programme tier, the percentage taken off five kinds of charge raised elsewhere in the collective: lodging booked in the holder's name, equipment rental booked in the holder's name, snowsports school bookings made in the holder's name, on-mountain dining charged to the holder, and resort retail purchases by the holder.

| Tier | Lodging | Equipment rental | Snowsports school | On-mountain dining | Resort retail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | 0 per cent | 10 per cent | 0 per cent | 0 per cent | 10 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 5 per cent | 15 per cent | 5 per cent | 5 per cent | 10 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | 10 per cent | 20 per cent | 10 per cent | 10 per cent | 15 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | 12.5 per cent | 20 per cent | 15 per cent | 10 per cent | 15 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | 15 per cent | 25 per cent | 15 per cent | 15 per cent | 20 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | 20 per cent | 30 per cent | 20 per cent | 15 per cent | 20 per cent |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | 25 per cent | 35 per cent | 25 per cent | 20 per cent | 25 per cent |

Every figure in this schedule is a percentage taken off a charge raised on the household, never an amount in USD and never a balance held on the pass.

Equipment rental carries the largest reduction on every tier of the programme, and the Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass carries a published figure of 0 per cent on lodging, snowsports school and on-mountain dining.
